findings.residual_risk: the space of hypotheses in this plan is Held-out-informed. C4 exists because the decomposition showed the triggering improvements were negligible; E0 exists because a mu_max pattern was visible in the frozen taxonomy. v2's design is Held-out-informed at the hypothesis level and Held-out-blind at the parameter level. That is the strongest available protection and it is not complete protection.

findings.attack: ladders centred on v1's operating point would produce rules tuned to v1's difficulty
findings.mitigation: E1's alpha ladder runs 0.25x to 2x the frozen amplitude and E3's c ladder 0.25 to 2.2 against a frozen support of U(0.25,0.55); both locate a threshold rather than verify a verdict, and the located thresholds are the headline results
findings.residual_risk: fresh worlds use the same generator machinery, so any defect in it is inherited; descriptor is min-max normalised per sample and correlated_distractor is unrenormalised. A full generator audit is not in this plan and is recorded as an open item.

findings.attack: E1 evaluates about 5 criteria against about 20 rule combinations across 51 cells; something will look admissible by chance
findings.mitigation: admissibility is a conjunction of pre-declared absolute thresholds rather than a best-of-K ranking; the tie-break is a pre-declared lexicographic order with fewest-free-parameters first; a sealed CONFIRM split opened exactly once provides internal replication
findings.residual_risk: a conjunction of five thresholds evaluated at thousands of points still has a non-trivial family-wise error rate, and CONFIRM is only 20 percent so its own power is limited. If the selected pair fails CONFIRM the plan requires reporting non-replication rather than trying the next pair, and that rule must be honoured even when it costs the whole study.

That is a governance control, not a technical one, and its only real protection is that the rationale is committed before the new magnitude is chosen and is therefore auditable after the fact.
